## Ins and Outs
```{r}
segments<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA","M","NS")
segments.ms<-segments%>% mixedsort()
#iqtrees
tree.fold<-"../../02_iqtree/iq_gtrfr10_rooted/"
trees.in<-list.files(tree.fold,pattern = ".treefile",full.names = T) %>%
  mixedsort()

l.tr<-length(trees.in)

#genoflu genotypes
geno.in<-"../../../data/05_annotate/02_genoflu/summarize_genoflu/2026-01-12_out/geno_sep_wide.csv"
geno2.in<-"../../../data/05_annotate/02_genoflu/summarize_genoflu/2026-04-30_summary/summarized_genoflu_meta.csv"
#geno sample lookup
geno.samp.in<-"../../../data/05_annotate/02_genoflu/genoflu/geno_sample.csv"

#metadata to connect seq_new to sample
#use the filtered metadata after removing temp outliers
meta.fold<-"../../01_fasttree/ft_rooted_outliers/2026-01-14_rem-outliers/rem_out/"
meta.in<-list.files(meta.fold, pattern="resid.csv",full.names = T) %>%
  mixedsort()

#filled clade labels from genoflu_clades pipeline
clades.fold<-"../genoflu_clades/2026-05-06_out/"

#outputs
today<-Sys.Date()
f.out<-paste0(today,"_out/")
if(!dir.exists(f.out)){dir.create(f.out)}
```

## Read in the trees, meta, and genoflu data
```{r}
meta<-trees<-replicate(n=l.tr, vector())
for(i in 1:l.tr){
  trees[[i]]<-ape::read.tree(trees.in[i])
  meta[[i]]<-read.csv(meta.in[i])
}

## read in the genoflu genotypes
genos<-read.csv(geno.in)
genos<-genos %>% select(-X)

genos2<-read.csv(geno2.in)
# genos2<-genos2 %>% select(-X)

genosamp<-read.csv(geno.samp.in)
```

## Connect all this data together
```{r}
#join these for samples
colnames(genos)[c(1,2)]<-c("geno_sample", "sample")
genos.all<-left_join(genos,genosamp, by="geno_sample")
length(which(is.na(genos.all$sample)))==0 #shouldn't be NAs

#metadata is segment specific, so add the genotype and segment clade to meta
keepcols<-which(colnames(genos.all)%in%c("genotype","sample"))
#note NA segment is xNA in genos.all
for (i in 1:l.tr){
  myseg<-meta[[i]]$segment[1]
  mycol<-which(colnames(genos.all)==myseg)
  if(is.na(myseg)){mycol<-which(colnames(genos.all)=="xNA")}
  tempdf<-genos.all[,c(keepcols,mycol)]
  colnames(tempdf)<-c("sample","genoflu_genotype","genoflu_cluster")
  meta[[i]]<-left_join(meta[[i]], tempdf, by="sample")
}

## check all tree's tipnames match meta
for (i in 1:l.tr){
  print(all(trees[[i]]$tip.label %in% meta[[i]]$seq_new))
}
```

## Plot trees: original genoflu_genotype (NAs in grey show incompleteness)
```{r}
# top genotypes by frequency get distinctive Okabe-Ito colors; rare genotypes get muted purples
okabe_ito<-c("#E69F00","#56B4E9","#009E73","#F0E442","#0072B2","#D55E00","#CC79A7")

genotype.cols<-replicate(vector,n=l.tr)
for (i in 1:l.tr){
  segment<-meta[[i]]$segment[1]
  NN<-Ntip(trees[[i]])
  meta[[i]]<-meta[[i]] %>% select(-any_of(c("X.2","X.1","X")))

  ## convert Not assigned and NA to explicit "Unassigned"
  meta[[i]]$genoflu_genotype[is.na(meta[[i]]$genoflu_genotype) |
                               meta[[i]]$genoflu_genotype %in% "Not assigned"] <- "Unassigned"

  gt_counts<-sort(table(meta[[i]]$genoflu_genotype[meta[[i]]$genoflu_genotype != "Unassigned"]),decreasing=TRUE)
  all_gts<-names(gt_counts)
  n_major<-min(length(okabe_ito),length(all_gts))
  major_gts<-all_gts[seq_len(n_major)]
  minor_gts<-all_gts[seq_len(length(all_gts))>n_major]
  major_cols<-setNames(okabe_ito[seq_len(n_major)], major_gts)
  if(length(minor_gts)>0){
    minor_cols<-setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#c9b8e8","#8a6dae"))(length(minor_gts)), minor_gts)
    genotype.cols[[i]]<-c(major_cols, minor_cols, "Unassigned"="grey70")
  } else {
    genotype.cols[[i]]<-c(major_cols, "Unassigned"="grey70")
  }

  t<-ggtree(trees[[i]])+
    geom_tree()+
    geom_treescale(x=0, y=ceiling(NN*0.95),
                   fontsize=3, linesize=0.5, offset=200)

  t <- t %<+% meta[[i]]
  td <- t$data
  t2 <- t +
    geom_point(data=td[which(td$isTip & td$genoflu_genotype=="Unassigned"),],
               aes(color=genoflu_genotype), size=0.7, alpha=0.7) +
    geom_point(data=td[which(td$isTip & td$genoflu_genotype!="Unassigned"),],
               aes(color=genoflu_genotype), size=0.7, alpha=0.7) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          legend.title=element_text(face="bold")) +
    scale_color_manual(values=genotype.cols[[i]], breaks=names(genotype.cols[[i]]))+
    guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=1),ncol=3))
  t2; ggsave(paste0(f.out, segment,"_GenotypesTipColor.tiff"),
         width=6,height=8,units="in")
}
```

## Read filled clade labels from genoflu_clades and build longform genotype
```{r}
# extract segment name from filename (handles "NA" segment correctly via filename)
seg_from_file<-function(f) sub(".*trim_nodup_nuc_(.+)_filledClades\\.csv","\\1",basename(f))

clades.files<-list.files(clades.fold, pattern="_filledClades.csv", full.names=TRUE)

# read each segment's filled clades; rename genoflu_cluster to {seg}_clade_filled
clade_list<-lapply(clades.files, function(f){
  seg<-seg_from_file(f)
  col_nm<-if(seg=="NA") "xNA_clade_filled" else paste0(seg,"_clade_filled")
  df<-read.csv(f)
  df %>% select(sample, genoflu_cluster) %>%
    rename(!!col_nm := genoflu_cluster) %>%
    distinct()
})
names(clade_list)<-sapply(clades.files, seg_from_file)

# join all 8 segments into wide sample-level table
clade_wide<-reduce(clade_list, full_join, by="sample")

# trim leading/trailing spaces from clade labels
clade_cols<-c("PB2_clade_filled","PB1_clade_filled","PA_clade_filled",
              "HA_clade_filled","NP_clade_filled","xNA_clade_filled",
              "M_clade_filled","NS_clade_filled")
clade_wide<-clade_wide %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(clade_cols), ~trimws(as.character(.))))

# build longform genotype string: PB2{clade}_PB1{clade}_..._NA{clade}_...
clade_wide<-clade_wide %>%
  mutate(genoflu_genotype_longform_filled = paste0(
    "PB2", PB2_clade_filled, "_",
    "PB1", PB1_clade_filled, "_",
    "PA",  PA_clade_filled,  "_",
    "HA",  HA_clade_filled,  "_",
    "NP",  NP_clade_filled,  "_",
    "NA",  xNA_clade_filled, "_",
    "M",   M_clade_filled,   "_",
    "NS",  NS_clade_filled
  ))

cat("Unique longform genotypes:", n_distinct(clade_wide$genoflu_genotype_longform_filled), "\n")
```

## Cross-reference longform to genoflu_genotype alias and fill missing labels
```{r}
# sample-level original genoflu_genotype (with NAs for unlabeled samples)
geno_samp<-genos.all %>% select(sample, genotype) %>%
  rename(genoflu_genotype=genotype) %>% distinct()
clade_geno<-left_join(clade_wide, geno_samp, by="sample")

#look
# clade_geno[which(clade_geno$genoflu_genotype=="Not assigned"),] %>% head

# Make these NA
clade_geno$genoflu_genotype[which(clade_geno$genoflu_genotype=="Not assigned")]<-NA

# build alias: for each longform, what genoflu_genotype is most associated?
alias_tbl<-clade_geno %>%
  filter(!is.na(genoflu_genotype)) %>%
  group_by(genoflu_genotype_longform_filled) %>%
  summarise(
    genoflu_genotype_alias = names(which.max(table(genoflu_genotype))),
    n_unique_genotypes      = n_distinct(genoflu_genotype),
    .groups="drop"  )

cat("Alias table (longform -> genoflu_genotype):\n")
print(alias_tbl %>% arrange(desc(n_unique_genotypes)))
cat("\nLongform strings with >1 associated genoflu_genotype (check these):\n")
print(alias_tbl %>% filter(n_unique_genotypes>1)) #good if none

# fill genoflu_genotype_filled: use original if available, alias if not, longform if not
clade_geno<-clade_geno %>%
  left_join(alias_tbl %>% select(genoflu_genotype_longform_filled, genoflu_genotype_alias),
            by="genoflu_genotype_longform_filled") %>%
  mutate(genoflu_genotype_filled=coalesce(genoflu_genotype, genoflu_genotype_alias))

cat("\nSamples with genoflu_genotype filled in (was NA):",
    sum(!is.na(clade_geno$genoflu_genotype_filled) & is.na(clade_geno$genoflu_genotype)), "\n")
cat("Samples still NA after fill:",
    sum(is.na(clade_geno$genoflu_genotype_filled)), "\n")
```

```{r}
          legend.title=element_text(face="bold"))+

  t2; ggsave(paste0(f.out, segment,"_GenotypesFilledTipColor.tiff"),
         width=6,height=8,units="in")
}
```

## Quantify monophyly and Fitch parsimony score for genoflu genotypes
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ape);library(dplyr);library(tidyr);library(ggplot2)})

set.seed(111)

if(exists("segments.ms"))segments<-segments.ms
segments_positional<-sort(segments)

if(!dir.exists(f.out))dir.create(f.out,recursive=TRUE)

precompute_tree_cache<-function(tree){
  if(!is.rooted(tree))tree<-root(tree,outgroup=tree$tip.label[1],resolve.root=TRUE)
  tree<-reorder.phylo(tree,order="postorder")
  n_tip<-length(tree$tip.label)
  n_all<-n_tip+tree$Nnode
  parent<-integer(n_all)
  parent[tree$edge[,2]]<-tree$edge[,1]
  children<-split(tree$edge[,2],tree$edge[,1])
  post_nodes<-tree$edge[,1]
  post_nodes<-post_nodes[!duplicated(post_nodes)]
  desc_tip_n<-integer(n_all)
  desc_tip_n[seq_len(n_tip)]<-1L
  for(v in post_nodes){
    ch<-children[[as.character(v)]]
    if(length(ch)==0)next
    desc_tip_n[v]<-sum(desc_tip_n[ch])
  }
  list(tree=tree,n_tip=n_tip,n_all=n_all,parent=parent,children=children,
       post_nodes=post_nodes,desc_tip_n=desc_tip_n,node_depth=node.depth.edgelength(tree))
}

fitch_parsimony_binary_cache<-function(cache,x){
  n_all<-cache$n_all
  children<-cache$children
  post_nodes<-cache$post_nodes
  n_tip<-cache$n_tip
  S0<-logical(n_all);S1<-logical(n_all)
  tip_idx<-seq_len(n_tip)
  S0[tip_idx]<-x==0
  S1[tip_idx]<-x==1
  score<-0L
  for(v in post_nodes){
    ch<-children[[as.character(v)]]
    if(length(ch)==0)next
    i1<-ch[1];i2<-ch[2]
    a0<-S0[i1]&&S0[i2];a1<-S1[i1]&&S1[i2]
    if(a0||a1){
      S0[v]<-a0;S1[v]<-a1
    } else {
      S0[v]<-(S0[i1]||S0[i2]);S1[v]<-(S1[i1]||S1[i2])
      score<-score+1L
    }
  }
  score
}

# cluster_col controls which column to evaluate; NA-labeled tips are dropped before evaluation
evaluate_segment_clusters_fast<-function(tree,cluster_df,seg_id,method_id,
                                         cluster_col="genoflu_genotype_filled",
                                         do_fragmentation=FALSE){
  # exclude unassigned tips
  cluster_df<-cluster_df[!is.na(cluster_df[[cluster_col]]),,drop=FALSE]
  # prune tree to assigned tips only
  keep<-intersect(tree$tip.label,cluster_df$seq_new)
  if(length(keep)<Ntip(tree)) tree<-keep.tip(tree,keep)

  cache<-precompute_tree_cache(tree)
  tree<-cache$tree
  n_tip<-cache$n_tip
  parent<-cache$parent
  node_depth<-cache$node_depth
  desc_tip_n<-cache$desc_tip_n

  tip_pos<-match(cluster_df$seq_new,tree$tip.label)
  cluster_df<-cluster_df[!is.na(tip_pos),,drop=FALSE]
  cluster_df$tip_idx<-match(cluster_df$seq_new,tree$tip.label)
  cluster_vec<-rep(NA_character_,n_tip)
  cluster_vec[cluster_df$tip_idx]<-as.character(cluster_df[[cluster_col]])
  if(anyNA(cluster_vec)){
    n_missing<-sum(is.na(cluster_vec))
    stop("Missing genotype assignments for segment=",seg_id,"; missing=",n_missing,"/",n_tip)
  }

  clusters<-sort(unique(cluster_vec))
  cluster_indices<-split(seq_len(n_tip),cluster_vec)
  k<-length(clusters)
  cl_nodes<-integer(k);cl_sizes<-integer(k);cl_purity<-numeric(k)
  cl_type<-character(k);cl_frag<-integer(k)
  cl_mrca_depth<-numeric(k);cl_mrca_desc_n<-integer(k)

  for(ci in seq_len(k)){
    cl<-clusters[ci]
    tips_idx<-cluster_indices[[cl]]
    tips_lab<-tree$tip.label[tips_idx]
    cl_sizes[ci]<-length(tips_idx)
    if(length(tips_idx)==1){
      mrca<-tips_idx
      cl_nodes[ci]<-mrca;cl_mrca_depth[ci]<-node_depth[mrca]
      cl_mrca_desc_n[ci]<-1L;cl_purity[ci]<-1
      cl_type[ci]<-"singleton";cl_frag[ci]<-0L;next
    }
    mrca<-getMRCA(tree,tips_lab)
    cl_nodes[ci]<-mrca;cl_mrca_depth[ci]<-node_depth[mrca]
    cl_mrca_desc_n[ci]<-desc_tip_n[mrca]
    cl_purity[ci]<-length(tips_idx)/desc_tip_n[mrca]
    frag<-NA_integer_
    if(isTRUE(do_fragmentation)){
      x<-rep(0L,n_tip);x[tips_idx]<-1L
      frag<-fitch_parsimony_binary_cache(cache,x)
    }
    cl_frag[ci]<-ifelse(is.na(frag),NA_integer_,frag)
    if(cl_purity[ci]==1){
      cl_type[ci]<-"monophyletic"
    } else if(!is.na(frag)&&frag>=2){
      cl_type[ci]<-"polyphyletic"
    } else {
      cl_type[ci]<-"paraphyletic"
    }
  }

  node_to_cluster<-integer(cache$n_all)
  for(ci in seq_len(k)){
    n<-cl_nodes[ci]
    if(node_to_cluster[n]==0L)node_to_cluster[n]<-ci
  }
  nested_in<-rep(NA_character_,k);nested_out_n<-integer(k)
  for(ci in seq_len(k)){
    cur<-parent[cl_nodes[ci]]
    while(cur>0&&node_to_cluster[cur]==0L)cur<-parent[cur]
    if(cur>0&&node_to_cluster[cur]>0L){
      nested_in[ci]<-clusters[node_to_cluster[cur]]
      nested_out_n[node_to_cluster[cur]]<-nested_out_n[node_to_cluster[cur]]+1L
    }
  }

  cl_tbl<-data.frame(segment=seg_id,method=method_id,cluster=clusters,
                     n_tips=as.integer(cl_sizes),type=cl_type,
                     mrca_node=as.integer(cl_nodes),mrca_depth=as.numeric(cl_mrca_depth),
                     mrca_desc_n=as.integer(cl_mrca_desc_n),purity=as.numeric(cl_purity),
                     fragmentation=as.integer(cl_frag),nested_in=as.character(nested_in),
                     nested_out_n=as.integer(nested_out_n),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

  seg_tbl<-cl_tbl%>%summarise(segment=seg_id,method=method_id,n_clusters=n(),
                               n_tips_total=sum(n_tips),
                               prop_clusters_monophyletic=mean(type=="monophyletic"),
                               prop_tips_monophyletic=sum(n_tips[type=="monophyletic"])/sum(n_tips),
                               prop_clusters_paraphyletic=mean(type=="paraphyletic"),
                               prop_clusters_polyphyletic=mean(type=="polyphyletic"),
                               mean_purity=mean(purity[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),
                               median_purity=median(purity[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),
                               mean_fragmentation=mean(fragmentation,na.rm=TRUE),
                               median_fragmentation=median(fragmentation,na.rm=TRUE),
                               mean_mrca_depth=mean(mrca_depth[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),
                               median_mrca_depth=median(mrca_depth[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),
                               prop_clusters_nested_in=mean(!is.na(nested_in)),.groups="drop")

  list(cluster_table=cl_tbl,segment_table=seg_tbl)
}

if(!exists("trees"))stop("Object 'trees' not found")
if(!exists("meta"))stop("Object 'meta' not found")
if(length(trees)!=length(segments_positional))stop("Length mismatch: trees vs segments")
if(length(meta)!=length(segments_positional))stop("Length mismatch: meta vs segments")

do_fragmentation<-FALSE

# run for both original (pre-fill, many NAs excluded) and filled genotype labels
eval_configs<-list(
  list(method_id="genotype_original", cluster_col="genoflu_genotype"),
  list(method_id="genotype_filled",   cluster_col="genoflu_genotype_filled")
)

cl_all<-list();seg_all<-list()
for(cfg in eval_configs){
  for(i in seq_along(segments_positional)){
    seg<-segments_positional[i]
    cat("Processing segment:",seg,"| method:",cfg$method_id,"\n")
    res<-evaluate_segment_clusters_fast(trees[[i]],meta[[i]],seg,cfg$method_id,
                                        cluster_col=cfg$cluster_col,
                                        do_fragmentation=do_fragmentation)
    cl_all[[paste0(cfg$method_id,"_",seg)]]<-res$cluster_table
    seg_all[[paste0(cfg$method_id,"_",seg)]]<-res$segment_table
  }
}

cluster_metrics_all<-bind_rows(cl_all)
segment_metrics_all<-bind_rows(seg_all)

# combined output
write.csv(cluster_metrics_all,
          file=paste0(f.out,"genotype_cluster-metrics_all-segments.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(segment_metrics_all,
          file=paste0(f.out,"genotype_segment-metrics_all-segments.csv"),row.names=FALSE)

# separate output and plots per method
for(mid in c("genotype_original","genotype_filled")){
  cm<-cluster_metrics_all%>%filter(method==mid)
  sm<-segment_metrics_all%>%filter(method==mid)

  write.csv(cm,file=paste0(f.out,mid,"_cluster-metrics_all-segments.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
  write.csv(sm,file=paste0(f.out,mid,"_segment-metrics_all-segments.csv"),row.names=FALSE)

  plot_long_all<-cm%>%
    mutate(type=factor(type,levels=c("monophyletic","paraphyletic","polyphyletic","singleton")))%>%
    select(segment,type,n_tips,purity,fragmentation,mrca_depth)%>%
    pivot_longer(cols=c(purity,fragmentation,mrca_depth,n_tips),names_to="metric",values_to="value")

  p_all<-ggplot(plot_long_all,aes(x=value,y=log(..count..)))+
    geom_histogram(bins=60)+
    facet_grid(metric~segment,scales="free")+
    plot.theme+
    labs(x=NULL,y="count")
  ggsave(filename=paste0(f.out,mid,"_all-segments_cluster-metrics_hist.tiff"),
         plot=p_all,height=10,width=12)

  plot_seg_long<-sm%>%
    select(segment,prop_clusters_monophyletic,prop_tips_monophyletic,mean_purity,
           mean_fragmentation,mean_mrca_depth,prop_clusters_nested_in)%>%
    pivot_longer(cols=-segment,names_to="metric",values_to="value")

  p_seg<-ggplot(plot_seg_long,aes(x=segment,y=value))+
    geom_col()+
    facet_grid(metric~.,scales="free_y",switch="y")+
    plot.theme+
    labs(x=NULL,y=NULL)
  ggsave(filename=paste0(f.out,mid,"_all-segments_segment-summaries.tiff"),
         plot=p_seg,height=12,width=9)
}
```
